# bintables/global

> Global: stored in the data section as pk_g_<name>; the initializer is a store.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/global.pkg) · translates [std/global](../std/global.md)

The compiler reserves a zeroed `qword` for every global; this package only
renders the initial assignment, if there is one.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.
